result.brief: 提出概率对齐这一分布级世界模型准则，并构建 PAWBench 基准与 PAWEval 协议，将视频生成器的多次 rollout 转为物理行为经验分布，评估其作为随机世界动力学采样器的能力。
result.reason: Formalizes probabilistic alignment for video world models and benchmarks video generators as stochastic samplers of world dynamics, directly addressing video world modeling evaluation.
